name: OneUptime
summary: OneUptime is an open source monitoring platform with public and private status pages. The free plan has 1 status page and 100 subscribers. Growth costs $22 and Scale $99 on the plan cards, both with unlimited status pages and subscribers.

facts.text: Subscribers can be notified by email, SMS, webhook, RSS and Slack. Microsoft Teams appears on the page only in a section about team alerts, not in the subscriber list.
The sample status page labels its resource history from 60 days ago to today.
The code is open source under the Apache License 2.0, except an ee directory under the OneUptime Enterprise License. It can be self-hosted with Docker Compose or the Helm chart.
The 14-day free trial applies only to new paid accounts. Existing accounts that upgrade are not eligible.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: The page title says paid plans start at $22 per user; the plan card shows no unit. Unlimited status pages and subscribers. Billing is shown as monthly or yearly with no separate figures for each.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Same status page and subscriber limits as Growth. The plan card shows no unit, and the page shows no separate monthly and yearly figures.

hiddenCosts: The page shows a dollar sign without naming the currency and lists no separate monthly or yearly prices.
The plan cards do not show the billing unit behind the Growth and Scale prices. The page title says per user.
